artifact_review: The Router identified key artifacts: keypad blur/fusion (severity 2), screen texture anomaly (severity 1), and perspective distortion (severity 1). The Perceptual Quality Auditor confirmed 'compression' artifacts (severity 0.4/5 scale equivalent to low-moderate). The Geometric Depth Auditor found no major spatial failures. I am upgrading the keypad artifact severity to 3 (moderate) because the buttons lack distinct physical separation, appearing as a single textured blob rather than individual keys. The screen's lack of reflection/pixels is also a notable texture anomaly (severity 2).
